E0994

Teaching: a redundant `subject OP` on an arm head — the `if`'s comparison already applies it (D-IF3 / D-IFDIST1)

What

Teaching: a redundant `subject OP` on an arm head — the `if`'s comparison already applies it (D-IF3 / D-IFDIST1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0994

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0994: tests/ui/dispatch_redundant_subject.stderr.

Error [E0994]: drop the `subject OP` — the comparison on the `if` already applies it to every arm
  --> tests/ui/dispatch_redundant_subject.jet:11:9
    |
 11 |         c == .Active(id) -> { return "live:{id}" }
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `if subject OP { … }` matches each arm head against the subject, so repeating `subject OP` on an arm is redundant
 Fix: delete the `subject OP` prefix; write just the value or pattern
